enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and morning hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling kettle and making toast, eating breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Take kettle from base. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Plug in kettle. Press kettle switch. Open bread bag. Take out two slices of bread. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Take plate from cupboard. Take butter from refrigerator. Open butter dish. Take knife from drawer. Spread butter on toast. Take mug from cupboard. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Stir tea. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wipe mouth with napkin. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking messages on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send message. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home on computer with desk lamp: program planning and email coordination (no commute today due to the public transport strike)
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Enter password. Open email application. Check inbox. Open email. Read email. Click reply. Type response. Send email. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Open document. Type program plan. Save document. Make phone call. Talk to partner. Hang up. Continue typing.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Place on counter. Take cutting board. Take knife. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Take pan. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Clear dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Stretch arms overhead. Stretch legs forward. Stand up. Bend over to touch toes. Turn head left. Turn head right. Rotate shoulders. Walk around living room. Return to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon remote work on computer: online partner meetings and funding administration
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Enter password. Open video conferencing software. Join meeting. Adjust camera. Speak. Listen. Take notes. Leave meeting. Open funding spreadsheet. Enter data. Review budget. Send emails. Make phone calls. Update records. Save files.
Enter living room. Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Take pan. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Take plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink water. Clear table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse sink. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing with TV and game console
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on couch. Pick up game controller. Turn on game console. Select game. Play game. Pause game. Pick up remote. Change TV channel. Watch TV. Resume game. Play game. Save game. Turn off game console. Turn off TV. Put down controller.

Enter bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and planning the next day on phone, winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Continue reading. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make notes. Set alarm. Put down phone. Turn off bedside lamp.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Sleep.
